summary: I tested the plain-words reorganisation of the landing, merchants, dashboard and checkout screens in the frontend only, at 375px and 320px with Playwright. POST /api/guarantees was blocked at the network layer and was never sent. I placed no real orders. Maria still has 41 bookings covered and there are 0 kalshi_live orders. Almost every requested check passes: the copy, the section order, the testIDs, the Real orders on Kalshi badge, the collapsed hedge section, Show all, the replay link, 44px chips, Today preselected, no auto-jump after picking the weekend chip, and Booking confirmed with the refund OFF. Issues found: (1) at 320px the 'You earn' value is clipped to '+$27....'; (2) the weekend unavailable reason shows 'hedge' on the customer checkout; (3) the 'Official trigger' label is visible on the checkout; (4) 'Show all 10' appears next to 41 bookings covered; (5) the copy says '$45.00' where the spec says '$45'; (6) names and the header are truncated at 320px. No console errors. No deprecated Expo packages found.

ui_bugs.issue: At 320px the value '+$27.28' is clipped to '+$27....' (scrollWidth 130 > clientWidth 120). adjustsFontSizeToFit does nothing on react-native-web, so this big number does not fit. Reference: app/merchant/[id]/index.tsx:230

integration_issues.issue: The backend caps recent_guarantees at 10 (routers/merchants.py:116), so the disclosure reads 'Show all 10' while the metric says 41 bookings covered. 'Show all' is misleading.

issues: The weekend unavailable reason shows the raw backend text 'Too large for today's hedge budget — try a smaller booking or another date'. The banned word 'hedge' appears on the primary customer surface (checkout.tsx:208). Map it in the frontend to plain words, e.g. 'Not available for this booking size, try another date'.

The disclosure label 'Official trigger' is always visible on the customer widget (checkout.tsx:250). The banned word 'trigger' is on a primary surface even though the text inside is collapsed. Suggest 'Official rain rule'.

The widget body reads 'Get your $45.00 back' but the spec says '$45 back' (money(bv) uses 2 decimals, checkout.tsx:198). The success line has the same issue, money(result.guarantee.booking_value) at checkout.tsx:131.
At 320px the header subtitle is truncated to 'This is what your customers see when they...'.

The business name column is squeezed by the 'bookings covered' column. At 375px it shows 'Maria's Patio Taque...'; at 320px it shows 'Maria's Pati...', 'Bayfront Bo...' and 'Ice Cream S...'. Suggest a narrower right column, or letting the name wrap to 2 lines.
At 320px the header title is truncated to 'Maria's Patio ...' and the subtitle to 'Patio restaurant · Chi...' because the 'Real orders on Kalshi' badge takes the width.
The first customer row is named 'Test', which is leftover test data in the demo.
At 320px the 'New York City' odds row is truncated to 'New York ...' (minor).

action_items: Make the metric-you-earn and metric-bookings-covered values fit at 320px on web: drop the font size (e.g. 28-30) when the width is under 360, or stack the cells. adjustsFontSizeToFit is ignored on web.
In checkout, map backend unavailable reasons such as 'hedge budget' to plain customer-facing words.
Rename the 'Official trigger' disclosure label on the checkout widget.
Use money(bv, 0) or similar for whole amounts so the widget body and success line read '$45 back'.
Change 'Show all {n}' to 'Show {n-5} more' or 'Show recent 10', or make the label match the 41 total.
Merchants rows: stop the long names truncating so badly at 320px and 375px.
Optional: the success screen repeats 'You're covered' in the title and again at the start of the first line.
critical_code_review_comments: The auto-jump effect in checkout.tsx:67-69 is correctly gated by `picked`. Verified: the weekend chip stays selected after 9.5s of 3s refetches.
The success copy (checkout.tsx:127-144) has 'For the business' above the hedge line and no 'Check my coverage' button. The title 'You're covered' is repeated at the start of the body.
The refund-OFF confirm only POSTs /api/checkouts/declined when a refund was on offer. Verified: it was the only POST made.
seed_data_creation: None. Two refund-OFF confirms logged 2 declines via /api/checkouts/declined (no money).
context_for_next_testing_agent: LIVE real-money mode. Never tap checkout-confirm-button with rain-refund-toggle ON. Block POST /api/guarantees with page.route in Playwright. Maria (6add11451f0373a8576b5b40) has 41 bookings and 0 kalshi_live orders. The weekend KXRAINWKND-26OCT24 quote is unavailable ('Too large for today's hedge budget'); Today's 10/25 quote is $1.00 for $45. All customer statuses are currently 'Covered' (nothing settled yet), so the Refunded/Stayed dry labels were verified by code review only.
rca_of_issue: 320px clipping: react-native-web does not support adjustsFontSizeToFit, so the 36px value with numberOfLines={1} gets an ellipsis. Hedge word on checkout: the backend quote.reason string is rendered verbatim.
